design.meta.description: Foundations, components and business blocks of the Open Mercato design system, with live examples.
design.meta.llmsSummary: Open Mercato design system: foundations, UI primitives and business blocks. Every entry lists its public import path; blocks are imported from @open-mercato/ui/blocks/*.
design.nav.label: Documentation
design.intro.title: Build business screens from shared parts
design.intro.lead: Open Mercato Design documents the foundations, primitives and business blocks used across the Open Mercato admin and storefront. Every example on this site is rendered from the same gallery registry the product uses, with fixture data only.
design.intro.howFoundations: Foundations describe the tokens: color roles, typography, spacing, radius, shadows and icons.
design.intro.howComponents: Components are the primitives from @open-mercato/ui. Each page shows every variant with its code.
design.intro.howBlocks: Blocks are business-oriented compositions with an explicit props contract and no data sources.
design.intro.themesBody: Use the Admin and Storefront switch in the top bar to restyle every preview. A theme is a set of token values, so components never carry theme-specific classes.
design.intro.agentsBody: A machine-readable list of every entry and its import path, for coding agents and search tools.
design.index.foundationsLead: Tokens and visual rules every component builds on.
design.index.componentsLead: Primitives and backend building blocks from @open-mercato/ui.
design.index.blocksLead: Business blocks with explicit contracts: inputs, events, slots and states.
